meta.note: Street prices in USD. Prices were re-verified against live US retailer listings (primarily Amazon.com) on 2026-07-24 wherever a matching new, standalone SKU could be confirmed; parts whose exact new SKU could not be confirmed at re-verification keep their earlier last_verified date, so always check each part's last_verified field. GPU entries record a representative new add-in-board (AIB) street price for the stated chip and VRAM. Original sourcing: manufacturer pages, TechPowerUp, Tom's Hardware, and verified retailer listings (Amazon, Newegg, Micro Center). Performance tier estimates are TechFuelHQ editorial assessments based on aggregate review consensus, not first-party benchmarks (except where the part appears in a TechFuelHQ Open Bench Dataset, in which case the tier is anchored to first-party data).
compatibility_rules: CPU and motherboard must share socket (AM5, LGA1851, LGA1700)
Motherboard chipset must be in cpu.supported_chipsets (e.g. AM5 X870E supports Ryzen 7000+9000; B650 supports Ryzen 7000+9000 with BIOS update)
Motherboard ram_type must match RAM ram_type (DDR5 only at this generation)
PSU wattage must exceed sum of CPU TDP + GPU TGP + 150W system overhead, with 20% margin
Case form_factor must accept motherboard form_factor (ATX > mATX > ITX)
Case max_gpu_length_mm must exceed GPU length_mm
Storage interface (NVMe Gen5 / Gen4 / SATA) must match a free motherboard slot

performanceTiers.entry: 1080p high settings, 60+ FPS in modern titles
performanceTiers.flagship: 4K ultra 60+ FPS / 1440p ultra 144+ FPS / path tracing with DLSS/FSR upscaling
